meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把回复变成先给下一步、步骤编号、带时间估计的清爽格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果长回复总让你走神,希望每条建议都能立刻动手。
copy.tagline_en: Turn replies into numbered next steps with clear time estimates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long answers lose you and you want a clear next step every time.

howto.what: Claude 的回复会按适合 ADHD 读者行动的方式改写:第一行直接给下一步动作,多步任务编号列出,每轮重述当前进度,给出具体耗时估算,把已完成的部分明确讲出来,并压掉无关支线和客套话。
howto.when: 输入 /i-have-adhd 启用,之后一直生效,直到你说“stop adhd mode”。它对任何用户消息都触发,包括写代码、调试、闲聊等,不需要你主动要求简短。

say.note: 之后所有回复都按 ADHD 格式输出

say.text: 把这次部署拆成编号步骤,每步给个耗时
say.note: 会输出编号步骤和具体时间估算
退出该模式,恢复普通回复

howto.what_en: Claude reshapes replies for an ADHD reader: first line is the next action, multi-step work is numbered, progress is restated each turn, time estimates are concrete, wins are visible, tangents and pleasantries are cut.
howto.when_en: Invoke with /i-have-adhd; it stays on until you say "stop adhd mode". It applies to any user message, including coding, debugging, casual chat, even without an explicit request.

say_en.note: All later replies use the ADHD output format

say_en.text: Break the deploy into numbered steps with time estimates
say_en.note: You get numbered steps and concrete estimates
